GetBackupMemberInfo
Method.Implementation:
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try { Set pBackupMemberList = ##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New()
New $NAMESPACE Set $NAMESPACE = "%SYS"
Set tMirrorName = ##class(Config.Mirrors).GetMirrorName()
Set tResultSet = ##class(%ResultSet).%New("SYS.Mirror:MemberStatusList") Set tStatus = tResultSet.Execute() $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
While (tResultSet.%Next(.tStatus)) { $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Set tName = tResultSet.%Get("MemberName") Set tRole = tResultSet.%Get("CurrentRole") If ((tRole = "Backup") || (tRole = "Async")) {
Set tStatus = ##class(Config.MapMirrors).Get(tMirrorName,tName,.tProperties) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tMirrorAddress = tProperties("MirrorAddress")
Set tWebServerPort = ..GetWebServerPort(tMirrorAddress,.tStatus) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tListItem = tMirrorAddress _ "|" _ tWebServerPort Do pBackupMemberList.Insert(tListItem) } } $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Kill tResultSet
} Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus

Method.name: GetWebServerPort
Method.Implementation:
Set tWebServerPort = "" Try { New $NAMESPACE Set $NAMESPACE = "EAI"
Set tStatus = ..GetEnvironment(.tEnvironment,.tInstanceType,.tInstanceName) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tQuery = "SELECT PhysicalPort " _ "FROM IHC_EAI_System_Data.Instance " _ "WHERE EnvironmentType = ? AND InstanceType = ? AND PhysicalHost = ?" Set tStatement = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%New() Set pStatus = tStatement.%Prepare(tQuery) $$$ThrowOnError(pStatus) Set tResultSet = tStatement.%Execute(tEnvironment,InstanceType,pPhysicalHost)
If (tResultSet.%Next(.pStatus)) { $$$ThrowOnError(pStatus) Set tWebServerPort = tResultSet.%GetData(1) } $$$ThrowOnError(pStatus) } Catch eException { Set pStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tWebServerPort
